### Project Summary

The Space Mission Design Game is an interactive space exploration game designed to provide an exciting and educational gaming experience. The game consists of five different levels, where players complete space missions and explore the universe.

Each level offers different challenges related to space exploration, mission planning, and navigation. Players can control their space journey, complete objectives, and progress through different stages of the game.

The project is developed using **Python and HTML**, combining programming concepts with interactive game design. The main aim is to make learning about space exploration more interesting through gaming.

This project helps improve problem-solving skills, logical thinking, and creativity while providing an enjoyable space adventure experience.
details:
Project Details – Space Mission Design Game

Our project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive space exploration game consisting of five different levels. Each level provides unique space missions and challenges that players must complete to progress to the next level. Players can explore space, navigate through different stages, and experience an exciting space adventure.

How it works:
The game allows players to start their space journey and complete objectives in each of the five levels. As players progress, they experience different challenges and improve their understanding of space exploration.

Benefits:

  • Improves logical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Encourages creativity and interactive learning.
  • Provides an entertaining way to explore space concepts.
  • Develops basic gaming and computer skills.

Intended Impact:
The main aim is to create interest in space science and make learning more enjoyable through an interactive gaming experience.

Tools and Technologies Used:

  • Programming Language: Python
  • Web Technology: HTML and CSS
  • Software: Visual Studio Code
  • Platform: Computer/Laptop

Creativity and Innovation:
The project combines space exploration with gaming. Its five-level structure, interactive gameplay, space-themed design, and different mission challenges make it creative and engaging.

Factors Considered:
Our team considered beginner-friendly controls, simple gameplay, attractive space visuals, level progression, mission objectives, and an enjoyable user experience while developing the project.
